title: The adjunction $j_!\dashv j^*$ on module objects
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $j\colon U\to X$ an open immersion.
The extension by zero $j_!$ of [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek] is left adjoint to
the pullback $j^*=\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_j}\circ\operatorname{mapMod}(j^*_{\Ab})$
of [def-sfb-module-upper-star], by the adjunction obtained by composing
$\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha_j}\dashv\operatorname{Coext}_{\alpha_j}$
([sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]) with
$j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!\dashv\operatorname{mapMod}(j^*_{\Ab})$
([def-sfb-module-linear-open-lower-shriek]), and identifying
$\operatorname{Coext}_{\alpha_j}\cong\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_j}$.

proof.text:
The composite of $\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha_j}\dashv\operatorname{Coext}_{\alpha_j}$
and $j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!\dashv\operatorname{mapMod}(j^*_{\Ab})$ is an adjunction
$j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!\circ\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha_j}\dashv
\operatorname{Coext}_{\alpha_j}\circ\operatorname{mapMod}(j^*_{\Ab})$. The coefficient
morphism $\alpha_j$ is an isomorphism ([sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients]), and for
an invertible morphism of ring objects extension, restriction and coextension of
scalars agree ([sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]); in particular
$\operatorname{Coext}_{\alpha_j}\cong\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_j}$, so the right
adjoint is isomorphic to $j^*$.
